channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Killington ski resort is back on the World Cup circuit after a break in two thousand twenty-five. Mikaela Shiffrin, the most-winning Alpine racer ever, will compete this Thanksgiving weekend. The event expects twenty thousand spectators and two million viewers on television.

Vermont's eighty million dollar IT modernization project has been paused since April. A recent audit called the progress "unsatisfactory" and raised concerns about cost and timeline. Officials plan six more months to prepare before restarting the project.

Peter Greene, seventy-eight, of Pawlet was found dead in Mt. Tabor after a hunting trip. Vermont State Police searched with dogs and drones starting Saturday evening. Authorities say the death is not suspicious.

Vermont law enforcement will increase patrols from November twenty-fifth to twenty-ninth for Thanksgiving safety. The campaign targets impaired driving and promotes seatbelt use. Officials urge drivers to plan sober rides and buckle up every trip.
